page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.large belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family, built on KVM virtualization and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processor. The instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution ratio. Dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources remain isolated from neighboring tenants, preventing CPU scheduling contention on the host hypervisor.

The hardware configuration includes 2 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and operates without local storage or included complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Persistent block storage must be attached remotely over the network. The instance incorporates zero GPU accelerators, focusing entirely on general compute capabilities driven by high clock rate Intel Xeon execution cores.

With a balanced 1:4 processor-to-memory ratio paired with high-frequency dedicated cores, ecs.hfg8i.large is designed for tasks requiring single-thread performance alongside standard memory headroom. Primary workload fits include low-to-moderate throughput web serving, application backend services, build automation, light database nodes, and general utility tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.large is an entry-level virtual server within the High Clock Speed family, featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 4.0 GB per-core allocation. Storage is non-local, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps with no bundled public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators. Operating under KVM virtualization, this configuration delivers dedicated compute allocation suitable for compute-sensitive yet modestly sized tasks. It is matched to web serving, lightweight enterprise applications, microservices, and general purpose background processing tasks.
